usedFor: When a deal task is done in ActiveCampaign, Calendly creates a one-time meeting so the sales follow-up gets bookable time.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Task Completed” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Finishing a deal task signals the next step is a conversation, with its own slot rather than a shared link.

watchOut: Edits also fire “New Deal Added or Updated”, so one deal could book twice; start from “Deal Task Completed”.
